issue_request: FHIR-20164 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core Contract. It reported that Contract.relevantHistory misspelled Provenance as Provence and rendered the Provenance.entity reference as plain text rather than a link.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by db9628e610d433f249c33f27d53ceebde964008e, which Jira also records in Lloyd McKenzie's 2023-03-21 comment. That commit changed source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml so Contract.relevantHistory says Provenance.entity and uses the markdown link [Provenance.entity](provenance-definitions.html#Provenance.entity).
additional_context: Contract is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current combined branch has the corrected StructureDefinition source. A checked-in source/contract/contract.svg title still contains Provence.entity, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact; the authoritative XML source that drives the definition page is already correct, and the reconcile workflow avoids SVG-only source changes when authoritative source is correct. Community searches found no direct Zulip or Confluence evidence for FHIR-20164 that would alter the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current authoritative source already satisfies the Jira request, and editing only the stale SVG would not be an authoritative current-spec correction.
